title: Motorola's GrapheneOS phones will launch in 2027 priced higher than Pixels
summary: The private Android-based OS will expand beyond Pixels next year.
contentText:
According to the GrapheneOS team, the upcoming Moto phones will be premium flagship devices. The team expects pricing to be even higher than Pixel phones, which is saying something. The current Pixel lineup starts at $900 for the base model Pixel 11, a $100 increase from last year. The Pixel 11 Pro XL price has gone up to a whopping $1,300 this year.
